layout.body:
Renovation Efforts
Management is preparing to renovate apartment interiors beginning in October.
After renovating a few vacant units near the building, the main renovation effort will begin on the 10th floor and will include four to six units at a time. Each set of units under renovation will require at least two to three weeks to complete.

questions.stem: What's the purpose of the notice?

options.B: To make people move to new apartment
options.C: To inform the apartment will be in renovation

questions.analysis: What's the purpose of the notice? 原文依据：Management is preparing to renovate apartment interiors beginning in October. 这则通知的目的是告知住户公寓即将进行内部装修。 A：管理装修工作 → 不是通知的目的 B：让人们搬到新公寓 → 文中未提及 C：告知公寓将要装修 → 正确 D：寻找新公寓 → 错误

questions.stem: How long may a set of units take to renovate?
questions.analysis: How long may a unit renovation take? 原文依据：Each set of units under renovation will require at least two to three weeks to complete. 解析：一批单元装修至少需要 2～3 周，选项中只有 three weeks 符合原文。
